messages:
jordan: Quick async Q — we're planning to change the priorityClassName on the api statefulset (api-sts) from "high" -> "realtime" to ensure lower-latency nodes get the new pods. Before I open the helm/terraform PR can folks confirm expected preemption/rolling behavior and any gotchas with PDBs + STS?
Tess: Changing the priorityClass on the pod template will cause new pods to be created with the new priority. Kube scheduler may preempt lower-priority pods to make room for those new pods if cluster is tight. For StatefulSet rolling update, controller will create new pod then delete old one according to the updateStrategy/partition.
mike: Short checklist: 1) preemptionPolicy default is PreemptLowerPriority (so preemption allowed) 2) preemptionPolicy can be set on PodSpec (PreemptLowerPriority | Never) 3) PDBs can block deletions if minAvailable can't be satisfied — which can stall the rollout.
hana: Recommend setting preemptionPolicy: Never on the pod template if we don't want cross-app preemption. Also, bump replicas by 1 temporarily in the STS or ensure node capacity so scheduler doesn't preempt things unexpectedly.
jordan: Good call. If we set preemptionPolicy: Never, will that stop the scheduler from evicting lower-priority pods entirely? I want new pods scheduled but avoid evicting unrelated services.
Tess: preemptionPolicy: Never prevents the scheduler from preempting other pods to make room. That means the new pod might stay Pending until a node frees up. So either: (a) increase capacity / nodes, (b) temporarily add a replica to absorb traffic, or (c) cordon/drain a node where you want the pod to land.
mike: Also watch PDBs: if PDB.minAvailable == replicas and you try to delete old pod before new one is Ready, the controller may be blocked. For STS with RollingUpdate, controller respects PodDisruptionBudget on evictions but not on controller-driven deletes? Practically we've seen PDBs stall progress if minAvailable too strict.
jordan: We manage STS via terraform module modules/k8s/statefulset/main.tf and helm values in charts/api/values.yaml. Plan is to: set priorityClassName: realtime, preemptionPolicy: Never, bump replicas +1 for canary, update PDB minAvailable -> max(1, replicas-1). I'll open PR shortly.
hana: One more nit: if you change priorityClassName only on the pod template, kube will do a normal rolling update. For StatefulSet you can control which ordinals update with .spec.updateStrategy.rollingUpdate.partition. If you want one-by-one safe rollout, set partition = currentReplicas-1 and iterate.
Tess: Example snippet for pod spec we've used before:

```
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      priorityClassName: realtime
      preemptionPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: api
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 1Gi
```

jordan: Thanks — that snippet helps. For terraform, I'm planning to change the module input priority_class_name and preemption_policy and leave replica logic to helm override. Any specific terraform plan flags you want (e.g., -target)?
mike: For safety run `terraform plan -target=module.k8s_statefulset` first to preview. But don't target apply in prod unless you're 100% (targeting can leave state drift). Better do helm upgrade with canary first in staging/one cluster.
jordan: Agreed. My rollout plan: 1) apply to staging cluster via helm (canary replica increase) 2) smoke test 3) open terraform PR for the infra module so drift is reconciled 4) after green, apply to prod in AZ-A only, monitor for 15m, then rollout remainder.
deploy-bot: Reminder: when you push the helm chart to our registry the deploy pipeline will trigger the canary job. `ci:canary` will create a canary release with a temporary partition set.
infra-bot: I pulled recent node capacity metrics — cluster-1 has ~12% headroom, cluster-2 is 95% full. Recommend applying to cluster-1 first.
hana: Also update the runbook brief: add a rollback step (helm rollback + set partition back) and a note to watch for PDB-Stall events: `kubectl get events --field-selector reason=NotTriggerScaleUp` (or watch pod evictions)
jordan: I'll draft the PR and tag y'all. Action items: Jordan -> open helm canary PR + run in staging; Tess -> validate PDB minAvailable change; Mike -> sanity-check terraform plan; Hana -> add runbook snippet. Thanks :thumbsup:
